description: This file defines the interface DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService, which declares methods for handling deposit application workflows such as submission, modification, approval, rejection, withdrawal, and deletion within the savings component of the Fineract project.

classes.name: DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining operations for managing deposit applications, including submission, modification, approval, rejection, withdrawal, and deletion.

methods.name: modifyFDApplication
methods.description: Modifies an existing fixed deposit application identified by accountId.

methods.name: modifyRDApplication
methods.description: Modifies an existing recurring deposit application identified by accountId.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a deposit application identified by accountId and deposit account type.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverts an approval on a deposit application.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Processes withdrawal by applicant from a deposit application.
